Implemented and verified invite rate limiting.

- `InviteService.create(..., user_id=...)` now enforces limits.
- Constructor accepts injected `limiter`.
- Maximum: 5 invites per user per 60 seconds.
- Users have independent quotas.
- Blocked requests raise `RateLimited` without storing an invite.
- Quota resets after 60 seconds.
- Added end-to-end tests.

Verification: `python3 -m unittest -v` — all 7 tests pass.
